# Node React PG Fixture

A minimal Node.js + Express + PostgreSQL app used for testing `har`.

## Stack

- Node.js / Express API on port 8000
- PostgreSQL database
- React frontend (simulated)

## Running

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

API: `http://localhost:8000`  
Health: `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health`
